subject: general-science
general_outcomes: Relate General Science to technology and society to enhance the learners’ appreciation of the environment.
Select and use appropriate instruments to carry out basic science process skills to discover and explain the order of the environment.
Apply basic research and scientific skills to manipulate the environment and solve human problems.
Develop capacity for critical thinking through basic scientific skills and research in addressing pertinent & contemporary issues affecting the society.
Apply scientific skills for enhancement of innovations and entrepreneurial skills for development.
Use relevant skills and values to promote local and global citizenship for harmonious coexistence and appreciation of biodiversity.
Acquire adequate knowledge, skills and attitudes to enhance exploitation of individual talents for leisure, self -fulfilment, career growth and for further education and training.
Apply acquired knowledge, skills and attitudes for effective communication and utilisation of information in scientific advancement.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to explain the meaning of General science as a learning area.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to outline the importance of General science in human life, environment and technology.

assessment_rubric.approaches: Correctly outlines some of the importance of General science in human life, environment and technology.
assessment_rubric.below: With prompt, to outline some of the importance of General science in human life, environment and technology.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to relate General science to career opportunities beyond senior school.

assessment_rubric.below: With prompts, related General science to some career opportunities beyond senior school.
